newsitem.title: UK: April Brent system throughput down from March - Shell Expro.
newsitem.headline: April Brent system throughput down from March - Shell Expro.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Thursday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in April at 420,051 barrels per day (bpd), down from 498,972 bpd in March.
Average Brent pipeline throughput in the 12 months to the end of February was 487,347 bpd, Shell said.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland Islands, where it is blended with Ninian crude and exported as Brent Blend.
Shell Expro said the throughput forecast was preliminary and may be "subject to significant fluctuation".
